definitions.gloss: tax increase, tax hike, raising taxes
definitions.explanation: An increase in the rate or amount of taxes. Frequently discussed in political and economic contexts, especially regarding consumption tax increases in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{増税|ぞうぜい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増税|ぞうぜい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many voices oppose the consumption tax increase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会保障|しゃかいほしょう}→社会保障：04914_shakaihoshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{財源|ざいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{増税|ぞうぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government is considering a tax increase to secure funding for social security.

notes:
USAGE:
A politically charged word in Japan, where consumption tax (⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧) increases have been a major topic for decades. The tax has risen from 3% (1989) to 5% (1997) to 8% (2014) to 10% (2019). Discussion of further increases remains ongoing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧{増税|ぞうぜい}: consumption tax increase
- {増税|ぞうぜい}⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: opposition to tax increases
- {増税|ぞうぜい}⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: postponement of a tax increase
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{増税|ぞうぜい}: large tax increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{減税|げんぜい}→減税：13318_genzei⟧ (tax cut/reduction).
